import Mathlib
open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Herstein_exercise_2_1_27 {G : Type*} [Group G]
  [Fintype G] : ∃ (m : ℕ), m > 0 ∧ ∀ (a : G), a ^ m = 1 := by
  haveI : Nonempty G := ⟨1⟩
  refine ⟨Fintype.card G, Fintype.card_pos, fun a => ?_⟩
  have h1 : orderOf a ∣ Nat.card G := orderOf_dvd_natCard a
  have h2 : orderOf a ∣ Fintype.card G := by rwa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] at h1
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h2
  have h3 : a ^ orderOf a = (1 : G) := pow_orderOf_eq_one a
  calc a ^ Fintype.card G = a ^ (orderOf a * k) := by rw [hk]
    _ = (a ^ orderOf a) ^ k := by rw [pow_mul]
    _ = (1 : G) ^ k := by rw [h3]
    _ = 1 := by simp

open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Herstein_exercise_2_1_27 {G : Type*} [Group G]
  [Fintype G] : ∃ (m : ℕ), m > 0 ∧ ∀ (a : G), a ^ m = 1 := by
  haveI : Nonempty G := ⟨1⟩
  refine ⟨Fintype.card G, Fintype.card_pos, fun a => ?_⟩
  have h_dvd : orderOf a ∣ Fintype.card G := orderOf_dvd_card
  have h_pow : a ^ orderOf a = 1 := pow_orderOf_eq_one a
  calc a ^ Fintype.card G
      = a ^ (orderOf a * (Fintype.card G / orderOf a)) := by
        rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel' h_dvd]
    _ = (a ^ orderOf a) ^ (Fintype.card G / orderOf a) := by
        rw [pow_mul]
    _ = (1 : G) ^ (Fintype.card G / orderOf a) := by
        rw [h_pow]
    _ = 1 := one_pow _
